digit_probe.scope: Existing saved token-level teacher-forced probe; scores each target token with the complete gold target prefix available.
digit_probe.probe_definition: first six significant-digit tokens (leading zero ignored; sign, decimal/exponent markers, and EOS excluded), remaining digit tokens, formatting-only tokens, and EOS; tokenizer decode units were checked by the probe.
digit_probe.old_56_digit_probe: not measured in the saved recipe artifacts inspected; old training-loss diagnostic is aggregate/position-indexed teacher-forced loss, not first-significant-digit versus remaining-digit groups.

old_saved_training_loss_diagnostic.scope: Teacher-forced training-loss diagnostic from existing code/numeric SFT examples.jsonl only.
old_saved_training_loss_diagnostic.note: stored aggregate teacher-forced loss by recorded presentation/token position; not semantically grouped into significant digits, punctuation, and EOS

causal_limits: At old128 vs new A128, optimizer/trainer settings and total presentations are matched, but dataset size, source constructions, prompts, targets, target scales, within-example repetition, and resulting order all change together.
Similar cumulative assistant-target token counts do not isolate the effect of breadth versus repeated exposure; they only show that total supervised target-token exposure is nearly matched.
The 512-step correct arm is a distinct dose condition and cannot by itself attribute the 128-step old-versus-new outcome to any single data property.
The saved 80-row digit probe is teacher-forced and does not establish free-generation or general numeric reasoning; no matching old56 semantic digit-group probe was found.
